title: Modern 2K mode names

Apply targets a disposable image; disabling restores from a separate original source.

Witness all menu/title/prompt routes, pause/load/save labels and text width in game.

runtime.scope: Static literal/lookup references, exact readback, offline composition and offscreen Qt only. No game witness.

fields.name: modern_naming
fields.allowed: Boolean; Basic/Advanced false; Experimental conditional on all_strings_fit().

selectors.notes: Text mapping does not create MyCareer or a card mode.
